race.comment: FUEL ON THE FIRE (1) is a promising type who just missed this course and distance last time beaten a nose. Has good upside and can go one better. COLONEL BOGEY (2) has been in great form on the Devonport Synthetic and freshened since. Hard to fault and can run well back to the turf. BELLA CHINKARA (9) ran an improved race second-up but strips fitter again and extra trip a big plus. Same goes for SNOWDONIA (7) who is also fitter for two runs from a spell and looks ready to fire over the extra ground now. FIERCE 'N FABULOUS (3) is another who will relish the extra trip and has a good record this course and distance.
